title: Non--exchangeable mean field games with moderate interactions and common noise
summary: We study mean field games for large non--exchangeable populations with moderate local interactions and common noise. The finite--player system is driven by two complementary interaction mechanisms : a graphon--type structure, which encodes heterogeneous large--scale interactions between agents, and a rescaled local kernel, which produces a density-dependent interaction term in the limit.
